locations.name: Institute Headquarters
locations.description: A sprawling research facility buried beneath the mountain range. Endless concrete corridors, flickering fluorescent lights, the constant low hum of ventilation systems. Security checkpoints every fifty meters.

locations.name: Mountaintop Observatory
locations.description: A dome-shaped structure at 3000m elevation. The telescope mechanism dominates the center. Walls are lined with control panels and data screens. One wall is entirely glass, overlooking the valley below.

locations.name: Abandoned Mine Shaft
locations.description: A forgotten entrance hidden behind a maintenance closet. Wooden supports groaning under centuries of pressure. The air is damp and cold. Faint markings on the walls suggest recent activity.

locations.name: The Valley Below
locations.description: A wide valley stretching between two mountain ranges. Pine forests give way to meadows. A river runs through the center, glinting in the sunlight. Small village visible in the distance.
